I’ll run `gwas_qc` once against the saved FinnGen gallstones download object, without adding any mapping notes or invented metadata, then print the tool status and a compact QC summary.

```python
from mrcat.tools import gwas_qc

result = gwas_qc(
    downloaded_study="$ref:gwas_download_example/gwas_download_result/downloaded_study",
)

print("SUMMARY:", result.get("summary"))
print("STATUS:", result.get("outputs", {}).get("status"))

out = result.get("outputs", {}).get("gwas_qc_result", {})
if result.get("outputs", {}).get("status") == "ok":
    keys = [
        "label", "ancestry", "sample_size", "genome_build",
        "genome_build_reason", "canonical_path", "formatted_path",
        "risk_notes", "missing_requirements",
    ]
    for key in keys:
        value = out.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, (list, dict)):
            print(f"{key}: {value}")
        else:
            print(f"{key}: {value!r}")
    print("ARTIFACTS:", result.get("artifacts", []))
else:
    print("DETAILS:", result.get("details", {}))
```

Wait: result["outputs"] maybe contains status not at top yes. Good. But if result lacks outputs? Use get. After cell we need wait.

```python
from mrcat.tools import gwas_qc

result = gwas_qc(
    downloaded_study="$ref:gwas_download_example/gwas_download_result/downloaded_study",
)

print("SUMMARY:", result.get("summary"))
print("STATUS:", result.get("outputs", {}).get("status"))

out = result.get("outputs", {}).get("gwas_qc_result", {})
if result.get("outputs", {}).get("status") == "ok":
    keys = [
        "label", "ancestry", "sample_size", "genome_build",
        "genome_build_reason", "canonical_path", "formatted_path",
        "risk_notes", "missing_requirements",
    ]
    for key in keys:
        value = out.get(key)
        print(f"{key}: {value!r}")
    print("ARTIFACTS:", result.get("artifacts", []))
else:
    print("DETAILS:", result.get("details", {}))
```
